e: From eir + 's, or by removing th from theirs.
From Ancient Greek εἰρηνικόν (eirēnikón), neuter form of εἰρηνικός (eirēnikós), from εἰρήνη (eirḗnē, “peace”).
From eir + -self, in pattern of hisself and herself (construed as formed from adjectival her), or by dropping th from theirself.
